items.text: Heads up! An Invincible VS hotfix is rolling out to all platforms to fix the following.
Fixed an issue that would sometimes cause a crash when inviting players to lobbies
Fixed an issue where for Angstrom Levy's Ultimate would activate the full animation on Assist characters

Season Two of Invincible VS has arrived from the edge of the multiverse! Along with our newest Fighter Angstrom Levy, today’s patch features a new Mode and a whole lot more. Get the full details below!
New Fighter: Angstrom Levy
New Mode: Challenges
New Audio Accessibility Settings
Season Two Ranked Reset
New Premium and Earnable Cosmetics
A TON of Gameplay and Bug Fixes
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651866/82a31b9568e5c6d2b25e4fbdfa5619431146646e.jpg"]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651866/d4e9519e717cd215bbebefe2035a9eb6fa0c2ca0.png"]
Angstrom Levy joins the roster, bringing multiversal mayhem to the fight!
You can try him out for free in Practice Mode
See Angstrom Levy’s bio on our Fighter page
Challenges are LIVE, and you can hop in via the Training menu or by pressing Left Stick on the Home screen.
Check out our Challenges Overview article for full details on the mode and all the new rewards you can earn by playing.
Season Two of Ranked kicks off with this patch with the usual LP reset and a new batch of rewards.
Ranked Reset LP Adjustments
Players below Platinum I or lower will not lose any LP (0 – 6,399 LP)
Players between Diamond IV and Superhero I will lose 800 LP or be placed at 6,400 LP, whichever is a lesser drop (6,400 LP – 9,599 LP)
Example 1: If you had 6,500 LP, you would have 6,400 LP with the seasonal reset
Example 2: If you had 8,800 LP you would now have 8,000 LP
Players at or above 9,600 LP will be reset to exactly 9,600 LP
Example: If you had 14,000 LP you would be set to 9,600 LP
Season Two Ranked Rewards
Play 50 matches - "Between Two Worlds" Badge
Play 200 matches - "Multiversal" Background
Play 400 matches - "No 2nd Chances" Title
Play 600 matches - Prestige Color Variant for all Fighters
A new Audio Accessibility settings feature set has been introduced in this patch!
An "Enable Proximity Indicator" toggle has been added. This enables or disables a sound cue that gets faster and louder as distance between characters decreases
A "Proximity Indication Volume" slider has been added. This increases or decreases the overall volume of the proximity indicator sound cue.
Various sliders for core combat sound cues have been added. This includes:
Boost Meter Fill Volume - Increases or decreases the volume of the sound cue that plays when a point characters boost bar is filled to certain thresholds (half bar and full bar).
Super Meter Fill Volume - Increases or decreases the volume of the sound cue that plays when the super meter bar fills up
Boost Activate Volume - Increases or decreases the volume of the sound cue that plays when a character performs any boosted attack
Boost Dash Activate Volume - Increases or decreases the volume of the sound cue that plays when a character performs a boosted dash
Assist Ready Volume - Increases or decreases the volume of the sound cue when an assist becomes ready to use
We’ve done a pass and fixed several instances where you could perform a “Safe Feint” that circumvented the Active Tag interaction when done at a specific height
Fixed an issue where Bulletproof could put his opponent in an infinite block string while airborne
Ultimates can no longer hit assist characters (this was creating bad gameplay scenarios during blowouts & active tags)
Fixed an issue with Immortal’s Active Assist sometimes passing the opponent on Block Strings
Fixed an issue where Universa’s Crouching Heavy would launch air blocking opponents too high
Fixed an issue where Conquest was unable to complete an air auto combo properly on motion controls
Fixed an issue where Immortal could, in very specific circumstances, revive during Sudden Death
Fixed a rare interaction where Cecil’s Air Down medium could trade with an opponent’s Crouching Heavy and cause a warp across the arena
Improvements for Steamdeck Performance have been made for longer sessions that return to the character select screen repeatedly
The Lobby win streak display now correctly counts disconnects/forfeits
CPU opponents will now be able to manually Air Recover
Pushblock VFX now display in the correct direction across the board
Fixed an issue where Titan’s Stone Skin Armor did not correctly render on all skins / variants in Character Select
Fixed an issue where the Offscreen player indicator showed “0” instead of “P1” and “P2”
Fixed a rare issue where a match would not end even if an opponent had 0 hp left on all characters
Fixed an issue where some overkills on specific characters sometimes showed a black texture
Fixed an issue where Universa’s Taunt did not have mouth movement
Fixed an issue where Lucan’s Ultimate sometimes didn’t have proper screen dimming when performed on opponents
Fixed several delayed stinger / double stinger SFX + VFX on multiple characters
Fixed an issue where Atom Eve’s CPU could block during hover
Fixed an issue with Robot’s Flaxan Armor Skin where the cape would clip through his body
Fixed an issue where floating body parts would sometimes remain on screen after an overkill on the P2 side
Fixed an issue that could cause the same arena to be picked twice in a row during a ladder
Fixed an issue where the predetermined final arena during a ladder could be picked during the ladder
Fixed an issue where a specific type of disconnect could award both players the same result during Ranked
Fixed an issue in Practice Mode where setting all enemy hp values to 0 could cause a looping death

items.text: What’s up FGC! We're back with a new gameplay patch featuring a fresh round of balance changes. The focus for today's patch is on buffing up some of the underutilized and lower performing Fighters on the roster to help bring them in line with the rest of the cast. There are also a couple of pointed nerfs at two of the clear standout Fighters in the current meta to bring them down a nudge.
Get all the details below!
Increased range of grounded neutral special
Added 4 frames of armor to boosted forward dash
Slightly increased Charged Air Heavy damage
Increased Charged Air Medium damage from 50 -> 55
Increased Charged Heavy damage from 60 -> 65
Fixed an issue where Lucan’s Ground Combo route 2s - 5h - 2h whiffed on some Fighters
Added forward momentum to Lucan’s air down special
Slightly increased Standing Heavy (5h) damage and fixed an issue where this attack was double scaling
Increased chip damage on Super 1
Increased Lucan’s initial velocity when going into hover
Increased active frames on Forward Special
Increased Boosted Forward Special damage from 60 -> 80
Increased Air Boosted Forward Special damage from 45 -> 80
Increased Air Down Medium damage from 6 -> 30
Increased Down Special Stab damage from 60 -> 65
Increased Down Special Hook damage from 30 -> 45
Increased Air Down Special Hook damage from 50 -> 60
Increased Boosted Down Special damage from 60 -> 80
Increased Air Boosted Down Special damage from 45 -> 80
Boosted Down Special will go immediately into an attack now, another input is not needed
Overall, it should be easier to combo out of all Down Specials
Increased Super 2 damage from 200 -> 210
Down Special Stance into dash now immediately has projectile invulnerability (this move had several vulnerable frames before)
Reduced duplicate Red Health cost from 75 -> 50
If a duplicate does not get destroyed, but doesn’t make it back to Kate you will be returned the red health after 2 seconds
Increased Neutral Special Duplicate Shoulder damage from 25 -> 45
Increased Neutral Special Duplicate Overhead damage from 25 -> 40
Increased Neutral Special Duplicate Low damage from 25 -> 35
Added 3 hit stun to Neutral, Forward, and Down special during Super 2 install
Added Armor Break to Super 1
Increased Super 2 damage from 200 -> 210
Boosted Neutral Special now has projectile invulnerable during spins
Increased distance of forward dash and boosted forward dash
Reduced recovery on grounded forward special
Increased Boosted Neutral Special damage from 80 -> 90
Increased Down Special chip damage from .1 -> .2
Boosted Down Special no longer damage scales with each hit
Increased chip Damage on both Supers
Increased Super 1 damage from 180 -> 190
Increased Down Special damage from 40 -> 50
Increased Super 1 damage from 200 -> 210
Increased Charged Forward special chip damage from .1 -> .2
Increased Boosted Charged Forward special chip damage from .2 -> .3
Increased Ground Down Special Just Frame damage
Increased Ground Forward Special Just Frame damage
Increased Air Down Special Just Frame damage increased from 20 -> 70
Increased Armor stacks to 8
Increased Forward Dash speed
Slightly increased run speed during Boosted Forward Special
Increased Super 1 damage from 200 -> 210
Increased Super 2 damage from 70 -> 90
Updated nudges and pushback on blocked air normals to reduce float and prevent infinite block strings
Reduced damage on first 2 hits of Forward Special, and transferred that damage to the last hit, emphasizing the full rekka sequence for down and forward variants (20>20>20 to 15>15>30)
Reduced Neutral variant of Forward Special final hit damage from 30 -> 15 (thus 15>15>15)
Increased Neutral variant of Forward Special final hit Combo Meter gain from 6 -> 12
Reduced Neutral Special damage from 70 -> 60
Reduce Boosted Neutral Special damage from 120 -> 90
Greetings FGC! Are you excited for CEO? WE ARE EXCITED FOR CEO! Before we get into all the glorious mayhem down at Rosen Shingle Creek, we had a few bug fixes that had to ship.
Bulletproof and Atom Eve had no recovery after snapback, leading to an unfair active tag situation
Homing & Active Hitboxes have been improved to ensure Heavy Active Tags connect
If a Heavy Active Tag does not connect after a set duration, the attacker will perform an air recovery that will prevent combo follow-up

What’s up FGC! We hope you’ve been having a super-powered time with Invincible VS Season One so far. We’ve been keeping a close eye on the developing meta since Universa and The Immortal joined the roster and are back with a fresh gameplay patch right off the heels of an incredible Top 8 showing at VS Fighting XIV (congrats to Jads on bringing home the Conquest Gauntlet!)
Combo Meter Increase
Boost Dash Cancel (Air) Buff
Air Conversion Buff
Balance changes to a handful of Fighters
Various Bug Fixes
Get all the details below!

Overall, we wanted to give players more freedom in the combo system, so we’ve loosened up the combo meter to allow for more exploration. Combos will be longer and it will be easier to explore routes with a single character.

We also increased air reaction time so that it’s easier to connect with follow up hits against airborne opponents, and we are now allowing flying characters to perform multiple air specials if they utilize boosted dash cancels.

We also wanted to give more options to the player when recovering so there is no longer an automatic air recovery or air wall splat recovery, both need to be inputted by the player to trigger the recovery.

Lastly, Assist Breakers are very powerful and we wanted to increase their risk a little. Now once they are used, assists will not start health regen for 10 seconds. This will leave them with a lot of red health for longer.
[p align="right"]— Dave Hall, Game Director
Combo Meter
Combo Meter has been increased by 20% for all combos
Lowered the Combo Meter buildup on various “crowd control” effects (Ground Bounce, Splat, etc)
Assists
The Fighter used for an Assist Breaker now takes much longer before they begin to regenerate red health
Recovery Options
Airborne opponents are now in hitstun 10 frames longer before Air Recovery is possible, which should allow more consistent air conversions
Air Recovery options are now always manual and require a player input
These two changes should make converting a stray hit in the air into a combo more consistent
Air Wall Splats now have two additional recovery options
Forward Air recovery allows you to air tech with more height and forward momentum
Air recovery from wall splat is now manual and you can willingly slide down the wall (especially useful against chain command grabs)
Fixed a bug where inputting a dash could cause a faster ground recovery than expected on a few different moves
Boost Dash Cancels (Air)
For characters who can Boost Dash Cancel in the air, performing a BDC will allow you an additional special and/or boosted special move without touching the ground.
Allen the Alien
Fixed an issue where it was not possible to Counter Tag Allen’s Heavy Active Tag on the ground
Bulletproof
Bulletproof Forward Special now damage scales more quickly
Bulletproof Forward Special (Air) and its boosted variant can only be used once per combo in the air, to be consistent with all other characters on the roster (see Boost Dash Cancel (Air) change)
Fixed an issue where one input of Forward Special (QCF) would give two strikes instead of one
Reduced forward movement on second hit of Rekka to avoid accidental crossups
Bulletproof’s Divekick \[ Air Down Heavy ] now has less forward momentum on the ground after a whiff
Conquest
Conquest’s Ultimate now provides more blockstun on block
The Immortal
The Immortal’s Neutral Special now deals less damage
The Immortal’s Neutral Special now damage scales faster when used consecutively in the same combo
The Immortal’s Charged Medium now deals 20 less damage on the last hit and scales damage faster
Fixed an issue where Immortal’s active assist would raise instead of lower the Combo Meter
Lucan
Heavy Active Tag now correctly reduces Combo Meter
Monster Girl
Air Charged Heavy now scales damage less
Omni-man
Air Charged Medium damage reduced
Rex Splode
Rex’s Forward Assist no longer has a horizontal projectile, clarifying its intent as an anti-air option
Rex’s Forward Assist now has a 75 frame recovery after usage, making him easier to punish
Rex’s Forward Special & Down Special can no longer be cancelled into normals on block
Rex’s Down Special now has 5 additional recovery frames on the ground
Robot
Robot’s Divekick \[ Air Down Heavy ] now has less forward momentum on the ground after a whiff
Robot’s Back Assist now has 1 less missile
Robot’s Jumping Boosted Down Special no longer has an early breakout
Robot’s active assist now more consistently causes hitstun against all characters
Titan
Fixed an issue where Forward Throw into Delayed Active Tag would not connect
Thula
Fixed an exploit where Thula could use Heavy Active Tag to reduce CM twice.
Universa
Universa’s Air Down Heavy now deals 20 damage per hit (down from 40)

As part of our ongoing Competitive Support Program, we’ve added new Titles and Badges to everyone’s collection (listed below) representing each of our partners. These will be unlocked and instantly available for use.
Head to EXTRAS > COLLECTION > CUSTOMIZATION to find and equip any of these NEW Badges or Titles:
4o4 Esports
Arcade Shock
CEO
First Attack
Iron Grid
Juicy Game Night
Paragon
Space City Beatdown
UFA (Ultimate Fighting Arena)
VS Fighting
Lobby
Fixed an issue that would cause match performance to degrade the longer a lobby existed
Gameplay
Fixed an issue that allowed a kara cancel out of a projectile, creating an active tag and super to come out at the same time
Fixed an issue where some assists could continue their hitbox after an ultimate has been triggered
Fixed an issue that could cause back assist to come out when trying to quickly use forward assist while moving backwards
Fixed a few camera issues during matches with consistent rollback
Ranked Mode
Fixed several issues with handling LP gains for players that disconnect due to sudden latency changes
Fixed an issue with disconnects at the very end of a match not granting LP consistently
General
Fixed an issue with Subtitles during introductions between Immortal and Cecil
Fixed a repeating error message when playing offline
Hey Invincible VS fans! We’re back with another hotfix to address some more issues from our Season One update, as well as a couple of changes pointed at some of the play we saw at Evo.

NOTE: We know prep for VS Fighting is in full swing, so this will be the last patch before that event. We’ll be back with a gameplay patch that will include balance changes after the event, but with ample time for you all to get ready for CEO.
Fixed an issue with The Immortal’s revive animation so that it cannot be hit with a meaty on wakeup
Added hitpause for The Immortal’s Ultimate when blocked
Fixed a bug with Bulletproof's Forward Special which was causing reduced hitstun on hits 2 and 3
Multiple network performance fixes for degrading quality with repeated rematches, especially in long sets or lobbies.
Note: Please let us know if things feel better after these changes, as this is part of an ongoing effort
Put a fix in place so that countertags are more consistent against late active tags (seen at EVO). Will keep an eye on this to ensure our fix was effective.
Former point characters can no longer kara cancel into Ultimate or Super after an Active Tag (Thanks: DeAdLyxReBeL)
Fixed Powerplex's Cosmic skin color 2 icon to match his new orange color scheme
Fixed an issue where the title was loading/saving incorrectly (introduced with the June 30th update)
Note that this fix means any local playtime on "Xbox on PC" between June 30th and this patch going live will be reverted to the June 30th state
This does not apply to any players who have been progressing on Xbox Series X in the meantime, cross-progression will now track correctly
Small update for you all!
Steam Cloud Save support has now been enabled. Thanks for your patience while we ironed out some initial issues with the feature.

Hi everyone! We hope you all are having a blast with Universa & The Immortal. We're releasing a hotfix today with fixes to a few immediate issues. The team is currently going through Season One bug reports and assessing fixes to go out in another hotfix soon. We'll share more when we have an ETA for release.
We have fixed an issue where Zero Suit Mark skin was unavailable in the UI
We have made several minor fixes to the models of new skins / characters
Fixed Ultimates on Anissa, Titan, and Universa that could mistakenly hit an Assist in specific interactions

With our first Evo Champion crowned (congrats to Akuri__ and all the competitors), it's time for Universa and The Immortal to kick off Season One. Today's gameplay patch also introduces new progression unlocks, a reworked Rank distribution to ease the grind at the highest levels, and much more.
New fighters: Universa and The Immortal
Rank distribution band adjustments
Major sweep of Fighter-specific bug fixes
Save Data changes, including Steam Cloud save support
Endless Ladder added (Arcade Mode)
New progression rewards (Ranked, Story Mode, Ladder)
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651866/cda6d2eb26d9269a083679498dfa5a9634aa3238.png"]
New Fighters
Universa and The Immortal join the Invincible VS roster!
You can sample both fighters for free in Practice Mode
See Universa’s bio on our Figher page
See The Immortal’s bio on our Fighter page
Gameplay Bug Fixes
Fixed an issue where some “Air Boosted Dash Cancel” Fighters could perform a grounded Boost Dash Cancel in certain situations
Fixed an issue where Heroic Strike could consume all Boost Meter if used against an active tag during freeze frame
Fixed an issue where a ‘Jump Dash Cancel’ after a ‘Boosted Dash Cancelled Normal’ would force a ‘Boosted Dash’ out instead
Fixed the following Supers so that they no longer teleport the point fighter when striking the assist:
Battle Beast Super1
Conquest Super1
Anissa Super2
Monster Girl Super2
Dupli-Kate Super1
Anissa (Bug Fixes)
Anissa’s Neutral Heavy now moves forward correctly after a Neutral Medium (the neutral Heavy should no longer whiff)
Fixed an issue where Anissa's Forward Special would sometimes not have forward momentum during block strings in the corner
Anissa now has lip sync during her Air Super2
Ella Mental (Bug Fix)
Ella Mental no longer continues to AutoCombo 2 if AutoCombo 1 is blocked and Heroic Strike’d
Invincible (Bug Fixes)
Fixed an issue with Invincible Super2 when connecting with an assist character
Fixed an issue with Invincible Super1 when interrupted by Robot Assist
Lucan (Bug Fixes)
Fixed an issue where Lucan would perform a Light or Medium attack instead of Floating with dash macro (normally Light + Medium)
Lucan's Super2 now overkills
Omni-Man (Bug Fixes)
Omni-Man's Jumping Charged Down Medium has received a consistency pass on both hits
Omni-man's Super 2 has improved alignment against multiple characters
Monster Girl
Monster Girl can now more easily cancel her Jumping Forward Special on hit, leading to better combo conversion
Monster Girl can now Boosted Dash Cancel her Jumping Forward Special on block.
Rex Splode (Bug Fixes)
Rex Jumping Down Heavy no longer teleports the opponent if it strikes on the same frame as Robot assist
Season 1 Ranked Update

With the data we’ve gathered from Season 0 and the Open Beta, we’re now ready to roll out a new bracket system for your hard-earned LP that will compress the ranks together and make finding matches easier at all skill levels, while also keeping enough distance between ranks to ensure you always have players of similar skill to match with and new heights to reach.

Due to this change, you’ll also notice that when the season 1 reset rolls through it may congratulate you on reaching a higher rank than you thought you did—this is because we are still preserving all of your actual LP values. So, when looking at how our Seasonal Reset will affect you, keep in mind your actual LP value to determine where you will land in Season 1.
[p align="right"]— Alexander Stokes, Project QA Lead
Key Changes
Many of the higher ranks which previously had 600 or 800 LP Divisions have been compressed to 400 LP brackets (Superhero IV – Superhero III required 800 LP to climb previously)
New Blood IV – Silver I are all now 200 LP divisions
Gold IV – Guardians of the Globe I have been compressed to 400 LP divisions
Key breakpoints
Diamond IV now begins at 6,400 LP (previously 9,600 LP)
Guardians of the Globe IV now begins at 9,600 LP (previously 16,200 LP)
Season 1 Ranked LP Adjustments
With the above in mind, it’s important to know what your actual LP is to understand where the system will think you Ranked and place you accordingly, as it’s based off of the actual LP value.
Players below Platinum I or lower will not lose any LP (0 – 6,399 LP)
Players between Diamond IV and Superhero I will lose 800 LP or be placed at 6,400 LP, whichever is a lesser drop (6,400 LP – 9,599 LP)
Example 1: If you had 6,500 LP, you would have 6,400 LP with the seasonal reset Example 2: If you had 8,800 LP you would now have 8,000 LP
Players at or above 9,600 LP will be reset to exactly 9,600 LP
Example: If you had 14,000 LP you would be set to 9,600 LP
MODES
Arcade Mode
NEW: Endless Ladder is now available for Arcade players! Challenge limitless opponents to reach a new winstreak
Invincible Ladder now restores more health between fights, two weeks to live!
Lobbies
There is now an Arena Select option in LOADOUT which will determine the arena for Lobbies (P1 in the lane will always decide the arena)
You can now spectate and be in queue to fight in the same lane
Tutorial
Beginner: Launcher Follow
Intermediate: Offense: High-Low Strings
Intermediate: Offense: When to Active Tag
Intermediate: Offense: Boost Dash Cancelling
Intermediate: Offense: Combo Meter Manipulation
New Progression Rewards
Invincicast (Invincible skin) is unlocked for completing 10 Ranked matches in Season 1
Rex Sloan (Rex Splode skin) is unlocked for completing an Invincible Ladder during Season 1 or later
Mark Grayson (Invincible skin) is unlocked for completing Story Mode on Viltrumite Difficulty during Season 1 or later
Practice Mode
Universa and Immortal are now available in Practice Mode, try before you buy!
Damage Scaling is now available under Damage Data (as a percentage)
Several revisions to options labelling for better clarity
You can now reset to any character by pressing the corresponding assist button and reset buttons at the same time
Save Data
NEW: We have introduced a new and improved rolling Save System that should prevent data loss on all platforms
NEW: Steam Cloud Save is now supported
Online
Winstreaks now show up in each game mode for both players on various screens
Note that winstreaks are unique to each game mode (so your winstreak may be different in casual, ranked, or a lobby)
Made several optimizations to performance so that online matches should feel better. We are still looking into more improvements for the future.
Practice Mode
Practice Mode now has input delay options from 2 frames to 0 frames
Dupli-Kate's Low Attacks are now correctly labelled in Practice Mode when Damage Data is turned on
Matchmaking
Match Found pop-up is now responsive earlier after appearing
Ranked Mode
Ranked Mode now has a new FTUE that shows all Ranked Leagues and their associated icons
It should now be easier to read your placement match completion status on Cecil's Victory Screen
Fixed multiple issues so that LP gain/loss is now more immediate on the frontend (is always correct in the backend)
Replays
Improvements to backstep function during replays
Replays no longer loop on themselves and instead prompt you to quit or replay
Replays now show Ping data correctly when played back
Social Hub
Sort now works for Recent Players and Blocked Players in the Social Hub
Tutorial
Tutorial now shows the Dash macro for players
Lobby Mode / Spectator
Added 1 second delay for Spectators to better account for rollback
Multiple fixes to Host Migration
General
The highlight cursor no longer snaps back up to Single Player on first boot of the Main Menu
Fixed several lip sync issues with character intros
Fixed several death SFX during slowdown animations on kill
Fixed multiple crashes on consoles
Overkill gibs should no longer float when killed on the P2 side
Visual and physics pass on Viltrumite loincloths for less clipping
Subtitles now appear correctly during Story Mode on Xbox Series X
All Story mode progression unlocks have a notification when first unlocked
Player Profile should show Online Stats correctly now
PRIORITY - We are looking into an issue with match quality degrading after several rematches and are actively working on it
Season One may cause your LP to appear as 0 until your first MATCH FOUND
Season One new season message will show your LP and Rank as 0 if you are in placement matches
Sometimes disconnecting from a Ranked Match will cause the winner to gain double LP, while the disconnected player will lose double LP
For Replays where your opponent disconnected the label may indicate the wrong winner (this does not affect actual results and is only a UI issue on the Replay screen).

items.text: Thank you to everyone playing Invincible VS! The team has been reading all your bug reports and feedback. Below are details on our last two hotfixes.
Magic chain and light attacks are now true block strings
Assists used in combos will now scale accordingly to how many times they’ve been used (Forward and Back Assist will scale independently)
Sudden Death rework
Improved motion inputs as well as a slight increase to the damage buffer
Take a look, hop into a few games, and tell us what you think.
Assists
Assists used in combos will now scale according to how many times they’ve been used (Forward and Back Assist will scale independently)
Forward Assist will scale in 3 second intervals up to 12 seconds (3 -> 6 -> 9 -> 12)
Back Assist will scale in 2 second intervals up to 12 seconds (6 -> 8 -> 10 -> 12)

Alongside this, we fixed a bug where Back Assists would sometimes receive a 3 second cooldown rather than the intended 6 seconds during aerial combos. This bug saw significant usage in online tournaments via Invincible’s Back Assist.
Assists now regenerate Boost meter and Red Health slower during the match
Assists no longer regenerate Red Health during Ultimate animations
Block Strings
Magic Chain is now a true block string (5L -> 5M -> 5H)
Crouching mediums are not always true block strings (both into and out of during a combo)
Projectile normals still do not create true block strings at longer ranges (Cecil players beware!)
All light attacks are true block strings (5L -> 2L -> 5L)
The defender now gains Boost Meter slightly faster while in Block Stun
Sudden Death
Fighters not in the point position at the start of Sudden Death, now remain alive during Sudden Death (until killed)
Fighters cannot regenerate red health by any means
Point fighters always have increased boost regeneration
Removed Round Resets/Punch-Ins during Sudden Death
Point fighters will slowly lose health when not in an active combo or block string (same as before)
Motion Controls
Damage buff for Motion Input users increased from 5% -> 8%
Loosened DP inputs (→ ↓ ↘) to make them more reliable
Atom Eve can cancel her hover by doing the same motion input again
Conquest’s DP (→ ↓ ↘) should now be more consistent, especially the follow-up hit
Reliability of forward walk into QCF (↓ ↘ →) should be improved
All Characters
Adjusted Active Tag windows on several Supers across the roster for consistency
Allen the Alien
Neutral Special no longer corrects direction between follow-up strikes
Atom Eve
Reduced Dash Distance (back dash ground, forward dash ground, forward dash air)
Back Assist now starts further forward and has a slightly longer recovery
Super1 now has more damage, higher hitstun, and wider spread of projectiles
Super2 now has slower startup on super armor, more recovery on block, and less pushback on final hit
Battle Beast
You can now active tag out of Super2
Cecil
Dash distance reduced (all)
Back Assist now has slightly longer recovery
Super2 now deals the same amount of damage whether used grounded or in air
Conquest
Down Special now has more recovery between attacks, should be more punishable
Dupli-Kate
Adjusted jumping Neutral Special to more consistently connect with smaller characters
Forward Special follow-up no longer auto-corrects facing direction (Boosted and Normal)
Ella Mental
Super2 now deals the same amount of damage whether used grounded or while in the air
Invincible
Neutral Special now has less pushback on block and slower recovery, it should be more punishable
Forward Special now moves less distance forward and causes less pushback on block
Down Heavy now has less pushback on block
Active Assist out of Super2 should now reliably connect
Boosted Forward Special can no longer be active tagged until the end of it (this was an unintended punish on assist breaker)
Monster Girl
Monster Girl will now retain velocity on her forward dash during normal attacks
Back Assist is now further forward, starts higher, and has a longer active hitbox (you shouldn’t be able crouch under it anymore on small fighters)
Powerplex
Back Assist now starts further forward and has slightly longer recovery
Forward Assist no longer causes flip, allowing defender to recover faster
Super 1 and Super 2 startup increased to match other characters
Super1 gravity reduced during fall to prevent early recovery
Rex
Forward Special projectile angle changed to be aimed further down
Forward Assist now starts further forward and has slightly longer recovery
Robot
Increased Damage to Forward Special (Boosted and Normal)
Jumping Down Medium has an increased projectile speed but shorter active hitbox
Combo Meter gains slightly for repeated hits, and increased recovery
Charged Medium tuned for easier input and follow through
Air Down Heavy can no longer cancel into special or super on block
Air Down Heavy has slightly less block stun and can be punished a little easier
Air Down Heavy can no longer cancel into special or super on block
Air Down Heavy has slightly less block stun and can be punished a little easier
Save Data

We've had reports of save data loss, particularly on PS5, and have put in several safeguards to try and address this issue. However, we are still investigating and appreciate your detailed reports as we continue to look for the root cause of this issue.
Creator Mode
Rex’s Ultimate will now be slightly less offensive with Creator Mode enabled
Replays
Stepping backwards through replays should now be smoother
Watching a Replay will no longer change your control scheme to that of the Replay’s Match Host
Settings
Minimum input delay is now 1 frame, previously 0.
VFX
Improved the braid physics in Fighter Select screen for Battle Beast’s Invincible Universe skin
General
Updated the Move Lists for Eve, Ella, and Thula for clarity
Addressed several crashes
Tutorial
Added a button legend to tutorials that shows button mappings for each glyph (L, M, H)
Ranked
You will now return to match queue immediately after an opponent disconnects from a match
If you were queued from Practice Mode, you will also be returned there with the same character selections
The total “Wins” stat will now increase when opponents disconnect from a match in Casual or Ranked
Leaderboards will now more rapidly update your LP
More changes to make the frontend show LP values from disconnects appear more quickly (Will continue to iterate on this)
Lobby
Steam-level friends now correctly appear in the Social Hub
Host migration should now be handled faster and more reliably, particularly for console players
Improved lighting and shadows on the following arenas: Hometown Invasion (Day), Hometown Invasion (Night), Himalayas, Himalayas (Blizzard), Training Room, Nuclear Missile Silo
\[PC Only] pressing Numpad 0 during a fight on Hometown Invasion (Day) no longer shifts you into the Shadowverse
All Characters
Fixed several combo paths that would prevent a charged attack input (Atom Eve, Battle Beast, Allen, Conquest, Monster Girl, Omni-man, Ella Mental, Powerplex)
Fixed pushback on block for multiple DPs against cornered opponents
Anissa
Fixed a bug where Super1 would double cross-up the opponent during their wakeup
Allen the Alien
Fixed a rare bug with his Boosted Neutral Special that could cause a desync
Battle Beast
Fixed a bug with jumping Back Assist so that Battle Beast aligns properly with the opponent
Bulletproof
Fixed a rare bug that would cause Bulletproof’s Jumping Neutral Special to whiff the third hit on 2 specific combos
Super1 should no longer warp the opposing Point Character in when hitting an Assist
Fixed an issue where you could Boost Dash Cancel without meter cost out of Jump Down Special
Conquest
Fixed an issue where Jumping Neutral Heavy could not be Boosted Dash Canceled
Fixed an issue where a combo blowout during Conquest’s Jumping Charged Down Medium would launch both players across the entire arena
Dupli-Kate
Fixed an issue where Charged Down Medium could cause a misalignment for clones and assists
Ella Mental
Fixed an issue where Ella Mental’s Neutral Special follow-up attack would not connect with very close opponents
Fixed an issue where Ella Mental’s Boosted Down Special into Launcher could cause her to cross herself up
Invincible
Fixed several bugs with Invincible’s Super2 and how it interacted with assists
Fixed a bug where Super1 would not always overkill
Monster Girl
3rd hit of Forward Special can now be pushblocked by opponent properly
Omni-Man
Omni-mans jumping Charged Medium now scales correctly (the 1st hit was not handling damage scaling properly)
Powerplex
Fixed a bug where Powerplex could not chain 2 light attacks outside of auto-combos (by delaying input by 1 frame)
Robot
Ultimate will now overkill even if your opponent has Creator Mode Enabled
Titan
Fixed an issue where Titan’s Super1 would whiff 1 hit on cornered opponents
Core Systems + Modes + Arenas
Fixed a bug where the Match Client would sometimes see the wrong control scheme of the opponent in-game
Fixed an issue where lingering VFX would cover Super animations
Fixed a very rare issue where an Assist Breaker wouldn't come out (Thanks, WhatDanielDo)
Fixed several character down-specials with corner pushblock pushing you too high
Fixed an issue where with a specific timing with Active Tag (Heavy) you could cancel even if the opponent successfully Counter Tagged.
Fixed an issue where trying to call an assist directly after blocking an Ultimate would fail
Fixed a Motion Input bug related to L+M giving a light attack instead of a Dash
Fixed a Ranked Mode bug where the “You Won!” notification could remain on your screen sometimes
Fixed a Lobby bug where a Spectator would see their latency to the Match Host instead of the latency between the two players who were in the match
Fixed a crash that could occur in lobbies with many players leaving / joining a lobby (noticed mostly in online tournaments)
Fixed a bug where reflections would not appear on Training Room when being arena shifted into it
Fixed a bug where the Moon would be brighter when taken there via Arena Shift
Online Winstreak in the Player Profile is not accurate. This is purely a cosmetic issue.
Sometimes disconnecting from a Ranked Match will cause the winner to gain double LP, while the disconnected player will lose double LP
We are still working on ensuring LP is displayed properly in the frontend after match disconnects. As mentioned before, the backend is saving all results correctly.
Dash Macro: Lucan will cancel his dash with an attack when using a 2-button macro to Dash (such as with default Motion Controls)

During Sudden Death, if your point character dies while you have an assist on cooldown, the point character frame will have a ‘cooldown’ when swapped even if they are dead and cannot be called for assist
On first boot the game will revert to “Single Player” after a moment during the main menu flow
If the game is booted without an internet connection it may need to be rebooted to gain network functionality once your connection is restored
NOTE: This will be the last patch before Evo, so hit the lab and prep your tech for the big event!
General
Throws (forward & back) will now make the attacker invulnerable
Push block is now more reliable and should help combat unblockable setups
Active Assists
Grounded Active Assists (Forward Assist during combo) have been adjusted to visually appear more like overhead attacks where appropriate
Grounded Active Assists received a consistency pass on height to hit smaller crouched characters
Grounded Active Assists now have a more consistent distance so that they will not fullscreen overhead in cases of large pushback on block (except Battle Beast whose bloodlust could not be contained)
Motion Controls
An overall priority pass has been done on special moves when using motion controls so they’re prioritized over macro buttons (dash, taunt, throw, etc)
The DP > Medium input should now be more consistent (This was a bug with the input buffer on motion 2)
The second forward input when doing a Manual Dash should now correctly chain into a DP input. (Previously, three forward inputs were required to Manual Dash + DP; Thanks: Chewie89)
Note that DP motions are prioritized over QCF after a Dash, as with other fighting games performing a full half circle can override this priority
Made adjustments so back throws (Light + Special) are more consistent
Active Tags
You should no longer be able to circumvent the Active Tag interaction with Jumping Down Heavy -> Active Tag (Heavy)
Character Changes
NOTE: Any bug that we state “no longer applies multiple instances of damage scaling” means a combo with this move will now result in more damage than it did before the patch.
Allen the Alien
Air Boosted Special no longer applies multiple instances of damage scaling
Neutral Special no longer applies multiple instances of damage scaling
Atom Eve
Super 1 Damage scaling has been fixed in combos (less damage)
Bulletproof
Boosted Neutral Special no longer applies multiple instances of damage scaling
Boosted Forward Special no longer applies multiple instances of damage scaling
Battle Beast
Jumping Down Special no longer applies multiple instances of damage scaling
Cecil
Boosted Down Special (Grounded) no longer applies multiple instances of damage scaling
Conquest
Jumping Charged Down Medium no longer applies multiple instances of damage scaling
Neutral Special (Grounded & Air, Boosted & Normal) no longer applies multiple instances of damage scaling.
Dupli-Kate
Boosted Down Special no longer applies multiple instances of damage scaling
Boosted Neutral Special (Air) no longer applies multiple instances of damage scaling
Jumping Charged Down Medium no longer applies multiple instances of damage scaling
Ella Mental
Jumping Neutral Special (and Boosted) follow-up no longer applies multiple instances of damage scaling
Invincible
Invincible’s Super 2 is now an 'ender' and cannot be Active Tagged (similar to Lucan Super 2)
Invincible’s Back Assist will now perform his Down Special instead of Boosted Down Special, meaning it will no longer down hit and ground bounce
Invincible’s Super 2 can no longer be looped into itself (we’re ending this!)
Monster Girl
Charged Jumping Down Medium no longer applies multiple instances of damage scaling
Omni-man
Neutral Special and its Boosted version should now have a startup of 20 frames (previously 18 and 17 respectively)
Powerplex
Jumping Neutral Special (and boosted) Just Frames no longer apply multiple instances of damage scaling
Robot
Jumping Forward Special and follow-up no longer applies multiple instances of damage scaling
Jumping Down Medium no longer applies multiple instances of damage scaling
Robot can once again Boosted Dash Cancel his Divekick on block
Thula
Corrected all of her Specials to no longer apply multiple instances of damage scaling. This should help her combos a lot.
Titan
Boosted Jumping Neutral Special should apply one less hit of scaling.
Jumping Down Charged Medium no longer applies multiple instances of damage scaling
Boosted Down Special no longer applies multiple instances of damage scaling
Bug Fixes
Fixed several bugs with multi-hit projectile attacks applying damage scaling too quickly
Fixed a crash regarding Arcade mode
Fixed an issue that prevented SteamOS devices from launching the game
Thanks to everyone that hopped into Invincible VS during our launch weekend! The team has been reading all your bug reports and feedback and have details on our first hotfix going live today below.

Quarter Up is racing to both digest your feedback since launch and resolve the biggest issues—all while planning the next balance patch. That means the most urgent changes are going out in today's hotfix patch. We're targeting our more comprehensive gameplay patch at a later date.
No more Conquest Infinite (it was causing a little too much happy chaos)
Some general Quality of Life updates
Improvements for Ranked when dealing with disconnects (still more to come on this!)
Lots of bug fixes!

ICYMI - For those of you on Steam who experienced issues receiving your Deluxe Edition Cosmetics, Pre-order bonus items, and DLC Cosmetic purchases in-game, we read all your frustrations and apologize for the headache.

Last week, we released a patch that should fix the issue and include all the missing items to your game. If you haven’t already, you'll need to fully close Invincible VS and let the update download for the fix to take effect. Thanks for sticking with us while we got this sorted!
Read through all the changes below for a full list of everything in the patch.
Quality of Life
The tutorial feed now shows the Motion Input correctly
Descriptive text still references Standard Inputs
Default input for Taunt on Motion Inputs is updated to L+H (previously L+A1)
You can now skip match intros
Improved mouse focus/navigation when alt-tabbing on PC
Bug Fixes
CHARACTERS
Conquest can no longer chain Jump Charged Medium into itself
Conquest jumping charged Medium now scales correctly when repeated in the same combo
GAMEPLAY
Fixed how Rollback handles VFX
This should remove unintended strobe FX or lingering VFX when playing online, especially during Ultimate and Super animations.
RANKED MODE

Please note, as mentioned in the Known Issues section, the League Points (LP) update fixes are guaranteed in the backend, but you will still only see visual LP updates in the Main Menu on your next Match Found or after a reboot.
When an opponent disconnects during a match, the in-game messaging will now clearly state, “"Opponent disconnected. You win!"
Reminder that you will always gain LP when an opponent disconnects.
Players will always lose LP when disconnecting from a match
Leaving a Ranked Match using the “Return to Main Menu” path now has clearer messaging indicating that you're conceding the match and will lose LP
LOBBY
Fixed an issue where players couldn’t join crossplay-disabled lobbies in some situations
Several fixes related to Spectate
MOTION INPUTS
Improved Motion Controls handling of Boosted Dash inputs (previously, if you plinked it would have unintentionally cost a full bar of Boost Meter when you were off by one frame with the input)
Rebinding Taunt while using motion inputs now functions as expected
Fixed bug that prevented motion input players from entering passwords for lobbies
PRACTICE MODE
Setting Dummy in training mode to Jump should do a full jump instead of short hop now
STORY MODE
Fixed a bug where AI in Story Mode would get a 5% damage increase if Player 2 was set to motion controls in Local Versus
REPLAYS
Added messaging during the First Time User Experience to make it clear that replays from older versions of the game will be deleted
Replays will now be sorted from new-to-old by default
GENERAL
Fixed issues that caused multiple crashes
Fixed several uncommon soft lock states
Several localization fixes/updates
Opening your Player Profile from Leaderboards now functions as expected
Updated description of Active Tag Feint in the tutorial
RANKED
LP can sometimes take up to 30 seconds to verify on the backend after a disconnect (you should still always see it update on your next Match Found or reboot)
PS5: Rarely, you will get no error message when an opponent disconnects
Ranked LP is still gained/lost correctly when this happens
REPLAYS
Watching a full Replay will change your control scheme to the P1 control scheme from the replay
TUTORIAL
Pop-up windows explaining moves in Tutorial don’t always adapt to Motion Inputs (left sidebar is always correct)
STORY + ARCADE MODE
Missing notification when unlocking Viltrumite Omni-Man when completing the Story Mode on Hard difficulty
